# Browser barcode decoder

ZXing JavaScript library 0.21.3, Apache-2.0. Vendored UMD build from the pinned npm
package `@zxing/library@0.21.3`; license included alongside it. Upstream:
https://github.com/zxing-js/library

Used only to decode camera frames locally when the browser does not provide a native
BarcodeDetector. It makes no network requests and does not receive account credentials.
